finding.problem: PrivateTopicPreferences invokes external private authority open/read/narrow/assertLive without translating known storage integrity/availability failures. TopicLedgerError, TopicRoomLifecycleError and native filesystem errno are not DomainError, so app generic handler emits500 INTERNAL_ERROR instead of503 for unavailable private storage.
finding.qualification: Exact actual internal thrown error class was not retained; actual500 is confirmed and deterministic source-bound error classification gap is reproduced. No leaked private view or grant revival is asserted.

classification: Translate explicit TopicLedgerError/TopicRoomLifecycleError and recognized native filesystem errors only from these storage calls into sanitized DomainError503 (e.g.PRIVATE_TOPICS_UNAVAILABLE).
Rethrow unknown/programmer errors unchanged; no global app filesystem classification.
Do not wrap DB/auth/enqueue/general mutation functions or swallow errors; no cache/empty fallback, storage initialization, grant renewal or rollback of durable exclusions.
recommended_minimal_repair.corrupt_parser_limit: Ledger unpack/lifecycle decode contain raw JSON.parse which can throw SyntaxError. Do not indiscriminately map all SyntaxError in the adapter; if all malformed-storage503 coverage is claimed, normalize at the actual parser boundary separately and test it. Missing-chain fix alone does not prove every corruption class.
required_validation: Initial open/read and late read/assertLive/narrow storage errors produce503 and no private delivery, including taxonomy/planner consumers.
401/403/409 DomainError identities/statuses remain intact; unknown programming errors stay500.
Mutation failures roll back SQL effects while keeping any already published durable exclusion strict.
Fresh source freeze/build, focused tests and independent candidate review; rerun unchanged restore503 gate on new source and archive bothFAILs.
